Our Story

From The Shop Floor, Not A Catalog

Santa Cruz MFG is the rider-built parts line from Santa Cruz Metal Works — a real metal shop that actually machines the parts it sells. No drop-shipping, no rebadged imports.

The Black Widow started as a one-off for a personal build. Too many riders asked where to get one. So we tooled it up, dialed in the fit, and made it a product worth putting your name behind.

It's the first piece in the Webworks Series — a growing line of premium Harley hardware. Machined right, priced honest, backed by people who ride.

Order Yours
Questions

Good To Know

Will it fit my bike?

The Black Widow fits Harley Touring models from 2009 to present (Street Glide, Road Glide, Road King, Electra Glide, Ultra) and includes the docking hardware. Ride a Softail or Sportster? Those are coming — message us and we'll put you on the list.

Do I need extra hardware?

No. Every order ships with the docking hardware you need. Open the box, grab hand tools, mount it.

How hard is the install?

About 10 minutes with basic hand tools. No drilling, no cutting, no modifications to the bike.

When will it ship?

Orders ship within 1–2 weeks with free U.S. shipping. Once your invoice is paid, you'll get tracking as soon as it's on the way. Questions about your order? Email beck@santacruzmetalworks.com.

What's the finish like?

Choose deep chrome or powder coat in the color of your choice. Both are built to hold up to weather and miles.
